messages.content: Hi, saya Siti Nur, network analytics lead di MyTel HQ Cyberjaya. Kami nak launch satu network insight campaign untuk Q2 — hipotesis: jika kita offload TikTok dan YouTube traffic ke edge cache di Cyberjaya dan KL, p95 latency users muda akan turun bawah 50ms dan churn pattern akan berkurang. Boleh tolong define campaign hypothesis dulu?
Selamat pagi Puan Siti, terima kasih kerana menghubungi network intelligence helpdesk. Saya akan mendaftarkan campaign hypothesis Puan sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: define_campaign_hypothesis
function.arguments: {"name": "Edge Cache Offload TikTok+YouTube Q2 2026", "description": "Test whether offloading TikTok and YouTube traffic to edge caches in Cyberjaya and KL reduces p95 latency for youth segment subscribers and lowers churn signals.", "owner": {"user_id": "usr-siti-nwk", "team": "network_analytics", "email": "siti.nur@mytel.com.my"}, "timeframe": {"start_date": "2026-06-01", "end_date": "2026-08-31", "timezone": "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur"}, "hypotheses": [{"id": "h1", "statement": "Edge caching for TikTok and YouTube will reduce p95 latency below 50ms for youth segment", "expected_effect": "reduce_latency"}, {"id": "h2", "statement": "Improved video QoE will reduce 60-day churn signals among youth segment by 10%", "expected_effect": "reduce_churn"}], "target_segments": [{"name": "youth_klang_valley", "criteria": {"age_band": "18-25", "region": ["MY-KL", "MY-Cyberjaya"], "plan_type": ["prepaid", "postpaid_entry"]}}], "success_criteria": [{"metric": "p95_video_latency_ms", "operator": "<=", "value": 50}, {"metric": "churn_signal_reduction_pct", "operator": ">=", "value": 10}]}

messages.name: define_campaign_hypothesis
messages.content: {"campaign_id": "cmp-edge-tt-yt-2026q2", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T10:02:00+08:00", "version": 1, "hypotheses_registered": 2, "target_segments_registered": 1, "success_criteria_registered": 2}

Campaign telah didaftarkan, Puan:

- **Campaign ID:** `cmp-edge-tt-yt-2026q2`
- **Status:** draft (versi 1)
- 2 hipotesis, 1 segmen target, 2 success criteria

Langkah seterusnya adalah design network segments yang lebih granular dan configure KPI baseline. Adakah Puan ingin meneruskan dengan dua-dua langkah?

Yes. Design dua network segments — 'youth_kl_cyber_video_heavy' (data usage video >5GB/week) dan 'youth_kl_cyber_video_light' (<2GB/week) sebagai control. Lepas tu configure KPI dengan baseline window 30 hari terakhir.
Baik Puan. Saya akan reka kedua-dua segmen dan configure KPI baseline secara serentak.

messages.content: {"campaign_id": "cmp-edge-tt-yt-2026q2", "segments_created": [{"segment_id": "seg-yth-heavy-001", "name": "youth_kl_cyber_video_heavy", "estimated_subscribers": 84200}, {"segment_id": "seg-yth-light-002", "name": "youth_kl_cyber_video_light", "estimated_subscribers": 51800}]}

messages.name: configure_kpis_and_baseline
messages.content: {"campaign_id": "cmp-edge-tt-yt-2026q2", "kpis_configured": 4, "baseline_snapshot": {"p95_video_latency_ms": 87, "video_buffer_ratio_pct": 3.4, "churn_signal_score": 0.62, "edge_cache_hit_ratio_pct": 12}, "baseline_window": {"from": "2026-04-21T00:00:00+08:00", "to": "2026-05-20T23:59:59+08:00"}}

Segmen dan KPI baseline siap, Puan:

**Segmen:**
- `seg-yth-heavy-001` (treatment): 84,200 subscriber
- `seg-yth-light-002` (control): 51,800 subscriber

**Baseline KPI 30 hari:**
- p95 video latency: **87 ms** (target ≤50ms)
- Video buffer ratio: 3.4% (target ≤1.5%)
- Churn signal score: 0.62
- Edge cache hit ratio: 12% (target ≥80%)

Jurang besar — banyak ruang untuk improvement. Adakah Puan ingin run traffic simulation untuk dua scenario sebelum activation: (1) full offload, (2) partial offload 50% peak hours?

Yes run simulation untuk full offload scenario first. Traffic model peak hour 7pm-11pm weekday, projection 1 month. Network changes: enable edge cache TikTok dan YouTube di edge nodes cyber-01, kl-03. Lepas tu tarik simulation results.
Baik Puan. Saya akan jalankan simulation full offload sekarang.

messages.content: {"scenario_id": "scn-77810", "campaign_id": "cmp-edge-tt-yt-2026q2", "job_id": "job-sim-cmp-998", "status": "running", "estimated_completion_at": "2026-05-21T10:08:00+08:00"}

- **Scenario ID:** `scn-77810`
- **Job ID:** `job-sim-cmp-998`
- **Anggaran siap:** 10:08 pagi

Saya akan tarik keputusan apabila Puan bersedia. Adakah Puan mahu saya cek status sekarang atau tunggu?
Cek status sekarang, sebab saya dah ada presentation 10:30. Pastu tarik dashboard juga untuk campaign ni — saya nak overview semua artifact yang dah dijana setakat ini.
Baik Puan, saya akan tarik status simulation dan dashboard campaign secara serentak.

Puan, keputusan untuk presentation:

**Simulation `scn-77810` (full offload) — completed dengan confidence 0.81**
- p95 video latency: **87 ms → 38 ms** (target ≤50: tercapai)
- Video buffer: 3.4% → 0.9% (target ≤1.5: tercapai)
- Edge cache hit ratio: 12% → 81% (target ≥80: tercapai)
- Churn signal: 0.62 → 0.48
- Backbone traffic reduction: 27%
- Kos tambah: ~RM 18,400/bulan
- Amaran: memori edge node peak 78% 8-9pm

**Dashboard:** 1 draft (campaign ini), 5 aktif, 2 dalam approval queue.

Keputusan sangat positif. Adakah Puan ingin propose network changes dari hasil ini menjadi formal change request, atau cuba scenario kedua dulu?

Memang positif. Skip second scenario, terus propose network changes from campaign — mode 'permanent', description 'enable edge cache TikTok+YouTube full offload at Cyberjaya and KL edge nodes based on simulation scn-77810'. Lepas tu request approval ke head of network Encik Lim.
Baik Puan. Saya akan propose network changes dan request approval secara serentak.

Based on simulation scn-77810 confidence 0.81: p95 latency drops 87->38ms, cache hit 12->81%, churn signal 0.62->0.48, backbone traffic -27%. Est cost +RM 18,400/month. Status, Puan:

- **Change request `chg-cmp-77001`:** draft, rollout strategy phased_per_node mulai 1 Jun 2026
- **Approval `appr-cmp-66102`:** pending Encik Lim, expires 23 Mei

Adakah Puan ingin saya assign owner kepada campaign dan tag dengan label yang relevan supaya mudah ditemui dalam dashboard?

Yes, assign saya sebagai primary owner dan Encik Lim sebagai stakeholder. Tag campaign dengan 'q2_2026', 'edge_caching', 'youth_segment'. Sambil tu link campaign ke radio planning project rp-2026-edge-rollout — sebab radio team perlu tahu pasal cache node load.
Baik Puan. Saya akan assign owner, tag campaign, dan link kepada radio planning project secara serentak.

- **Owner assignments:** Puan primary, Encik Lim stakeholder
- **Tags:** q2_2026, edge_caching, youth_segment
- **Link `lnk-cmp-44012`:** campaign informs rp-2026-edge-rollout

Adakah Puan ingin menunggu approval Encik Lim sebelum activate, atau Puan mahu draft activation rollout dahulu supaya sedia bila approve?

Encik Lim baru reply email, dia approve dengan condition memori utilisation dipantau ketat masa peak. Decide approval, lepas tu activate campaign dengan phased rollout — 10% week 1, 50% week 2, 100% week 3.
Baik Puan. Saya akan rekod approval Encik Lim dan aktifkan campaign dengan rollout phased.

Campaign telah dijadualkan, Puan:

- **Approval:** approved dengan condition memory guardrail
- **Status:** scheduled, 3 fasa: 10% (1 Jun), 50% (8 Jun), 100% (15 Jun)
- **Guardrail `gr-mem-85`:** auto-pause jika memori >85% sustained 10 minit

Campaign siap untuk dilancarkan 1 Jun. Adakah Puan ingin saya buat schedule recurring untuk evaluate performance setiap minggu sepanjang campaign?

Yes schedule recurring weekly evaluation setiap Isnin pukul 9 pagi sepanjang Jun-Ogos, action: trigger campaign performance evaluation. Lepas tu setup subscribe events supaya saya dapat alert via Teams kalau campaign auto-pause.
Baik Puan. Saya akan jadualkan recurring weekly evaluation dan subscribe events kepada Teams secara serentak.

Tak perlu evaluation simulasi sekarang. Tapi tolong tarik audit history campaign ni untuk pastikan compliance team boleh trace decision lineage. Dan kalau boleh, tarik campaign timeline serentak supaya saya boleh attach ke deck presentation.
Baik Puan, saya akan tarik audit history dan campaign timeline secara serentak.
